dz: 阿拉伯-拜占庭战争:阿拉伯人因为得不到足够的补给而放弃了君士坦丁堡的第二所阿拉伯围城,被拜占庭人击败了他们的救济军并爆发了营内的瘟疫.
de: Arab–Byzantine wars: The Arabs abandon the Second Arab Siege of Constantinople due to failure to secure enough supplies, defeat of their relief army by the Byzantines and an outbreak of plague in the camp.
